usage: Feat choice for chargen or level-up.

srd.text: _General Feat (Prerequisite: Level 4+)_ Increase Dexterity by 1. You ignore the Loading property of crossbows. Being within 5 feet of an enemy does not impose Disadvantage on your ranged attacks. When you attack with a one-handed crossbow, you can make one extra crossbow attack as a Bonus Action.
